verdict.rationale: The pack does not document a buy rate from Mangopay, the platform's ability to set its own sell rate for sellers, or interchange-level cost breakdowns. The only first-party fee mention says platform fees are wired monthly, which implies platform fee revenue but not configurable sell-rate pricing. The rate figures of 1.8% + €0.18 come from old community comments, not a documented buy rate.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I control the economics — a documented buy rate from the provider and freedom to set the sell rate my sellers see, with interchange-level cost visibility to manage the spread
